parameters.name: CredentialConfig
parameters.description: The China authorization configuration. **Leave this parameter empty unless you have specific requirements.**

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The highlight recognition mode. Valid values:

- Scene: scene and frame recognition.

- Average (default): average slice recognition.

parameters.name: Notification
parameters.description: The message notification configuration. For more information, click Notification. For the format of asynchronous notification messages, see [Asynchronous notification message format](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/imm/developer-reference/asynchronous-notification-message-examples).

parameters.name: Sources
parameters.description:
The list of media resources to process.
A maximum of 10 videos are supported.

sub_parameters.name: Duration
sub_parameters.description:
The duration of the media segment. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0, which indicates the end of the video.
This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to Concat.

sub_parameters.name: StartTime
sub_parameters.description:
The start time of the media resource. Valid values: [0, video duration]. Unit: seconds.
This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to Concat.

sub_parameters.name: URI
sub_parameters.description: The URI of the media resource (OSS URI). Only videos are supported.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The custom tags used to search for and filter asynchronous tasks.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The processing type. Valid values:

- Retrieval: highlight extraction.

- Concat: video composition.

- Compose: one-click video production.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The custom information, which is returned in asynchronous message notifications.
